[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Boreas Seabed | page name suffix=explorable area | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=247 }} The '''Boreas Seabed''' refers to the northernmost shores of [[the Jade Sea]] and its surrounding areas. There are plenty of [[Naga]] and [[Outcast]]s found on the frozen waves. The eastern end of this area is the location of the [[Luxon]]s' [[Convocation]]. {{TOCright}} ==Getting there== This area is right outside the [[Zos Shivros Channel (outpost)|Zos Shivros Channel outpost]]. It is a mostly optional area, but it does have several [[secondary quest]]s taking place in it. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: *[[Luxon Priest]] → [[Blessing of the
